trust_decision.summary: At the host dispatch boundary a guest-supplied method name is untrusted: it must only select a method the bound object itself defines, never Ruby's ambient reflection surface (send/public_send/instance_eval/method/instance_variable_get/...), because public_send(:send, :eval, code) reaches private Kernel#eval and host RCE. Decided once, in Kobako::Transport::Dispatcher#invoke (fix.diff:30-41, guard added at fix.diff:49-58).

landing_point.why: The summary's chain is 'method_missing -> public_send'; the only host-side public_send on a guest-supplied name is here (grep finds exactly two call sites, :114 and :116, both in invoke). The word 'method_missing' first sends a reader into the guest bridge (wasm/kobako/src/runtime/bridges.rs:113-138), which only builds the request and cannot invoke host code, so the sink is the Ruby dispatcher.

fix_sites.entry_point: Kobako::Sandbox#eval / Sandbox#run guest code -> Runtime#on_dispatch lambda -> Kobako::Transport::Dispatcher.dispatch (public module function) -> invoke
fix_sites.module_kind: host transport dispatch boundary (guest->host call sink)

fix_sites.entry_point: new reject_meta_method! called from invoke at the same boundary
fix_sites.module_kind: same file, new private module function (guard)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: docs/security.md:29 states the guarantee as 'only public methods of a bound object are reachable; send/public_send do not bypass this', so a solver can argue the named method IS public and the documented contract is already met; and because every guest name, from both Member classes and Handle instances, funnels through the single invoke sink, hardening that one place looks complete and the unvalidated guest-side request producer (wasm/kobako-core) looks outside the gem's trust boundary.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A dispatch to a name the bound object does not implement is documented to surface as host NoMethodError -> ServiceError type="runtime" (E-11), explicitly distinct from type="undefined" (E-12 target resolution); the published fix routes 'no public method and no respond_to?' into UndefinedTargetError, i.e. type="undefined", changing that documented taxonomy (docs/behavior.md:405, and encode_caught_error at lib/kobako/transport/dispatcher.rb:89-96). Second, near-sink break: docs/security.md:65 legitimately binds a Class (AppConfig); with Module/Class in META_OWNERS (fix.diff:21) every Module-owned method of such a Service (name, ancestors, ===) becomes uncallable, so a target-kind-aware fix is needed rather than a blanket owner check.

O6_input_shapes: method name arriving as an arbitrary String on the wire (Request#method_name is only type-checked as a String at lib/kobako/transport/request.rb:38), converted with to_sym before either call
both invoke branches: empty kwargs (no ** splat) and non-empty kwargs, which were two separate public_send call sites at lib/kobako/transport/dispatcher.rb:114 and :116
both target kinds that reach the same invoke: String Member path (resolve_path) and Kobako::Handle target (resolve_handle), lib/kobako/transport/dispatcher.rb:140-157

concretely-defined meta methods (public_method(name).owner in META_OWNERS: send, __send__, public_send, instance_eval, instance_exec, eval, method, tap, instance_variable_get, class) versus a name with no public method (NameError branch -> respond_to? opt-in for dynamic method_missing Services)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a host-side Sandbox#call(member, method, *args) convenience that invokes a bound Member directly without the wire
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the gem already has the symmetric #run for host->guest entrypoints (lib/kobako/transport/run.rb), so a directly-invoking counterpart on the host side reads as the obvious ergonomic addition, and it would re-implement invocation outside Dispatcher#invoke where the guard lives

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a Yielder that hands the guest a proxy for the yielding Service back into the same object (guest-block callback into the host object)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the block round-trip already re-enters the guest (B-23/B-24); letting the guest call methods on the yielding Service from inside the yield is the natural next feature, and its invocation path would be a second caller of a public_send-style sink

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the same name check placed guest-side in forward_to_dispatch/proxy::invoke, ahead of the wire
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the guest proxy already blocks construction of Member/Handle locally (B-38/B-39, wasm/kobako/src/runtime/bridges.rs:146-184), so a maintainer hardening the same property would plausibly add a guest-side reserved-name filter and leave the host-side check to be re-derived

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a Handles#call(id, method, *args) helper that resolves an id and invokes the object
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: fetch already returns the live host object and dispatch already treats a Handle as a target (lib/kobako/transport/dispatcher.rb:155-157); a table-level invoke is the kind of small refactor a maintainer makes when another layer needs 'call this handle'

O9_family: unsafe reflection / guest-controlled method selection into a host object (CWE-470) leading to host code injection (CWE-94), i.e. sandbox escape to host RCE

O10_build.language: Ruby host gem plus Rust (magnus/wasmtime) native ext and a Rust->wasm32 guest crate
O10_build.toolchain: Ruby + bundler (msgpack, rb_sys per kobako.gemspec:72-76); cargo for ext/kobako (wasmtime/magnus, long native compile); beni + wasi-sdk + vendored mruby via rake beni:build to produce data/kobako.wasm, which is gitignored and absent at the pinned commit (only data/.keep), see Rakefile:18-60
O10_build.project_tests: test/transport/test_dispatcher.rb is a pure-Ruby unit suite over Dispatcher.dispatch that runs without the native ext (test/test_helper.rb:10-28 requires kobako/sandbox on LoadError) and covers this exact sink; test/test_e2e_journeys.rb needs the built data/kobako.wasm; test/catalog/* covers the registries

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Denylist a handful of literal method names (send, public_send, instance_eval, eval) by string comparison and guard only the empty-kwargs public_send branch at lib/kobako/transport/dispatcher.rb:114.
